knowledge_reviewed: Agent-curated from listed extension and peer-reviewed sources on 2026-10-04; not yet reviewed by a plant pathologist.

evidence_model.description: score = 1 - prod(1 - weight_i * confidence_i) over recognised signals. Weights are agent-authored specificity assumptions informed by the cited symptom descriptions; not expert-reviewed, not fitted, not calibrated.

weather_model.description: Hourly infection-favourability heuristic: wet hour (RH >= wet_rh_pct or precipitation >= wet_precip_mm) weighted by a trapezoidal temperature factor; a day is favourable when it contains a wet spell >= min_wet_hours with mean temperature factor >= min_temp_factor.

temperature_c.note: Germination bounds/optimum from review citing De Jong et al. 1987; linear ramps between bounds are an assumption.

min_wet_hours.note: Lower end of the 6-24 h wetness reported for germination.

wet_rh_pct.note: Assumption: RH >= 90% used as a leaf-wetness proxy; no leaf-wetness sensor data. Uncalibrated.

wet_precip_mm.note: Free water from rain is required for germination; threshold is an assumption.

latent_period_days.note: Characteristic lesions appear 4-6 weeks after infection.

classes.note: Class thresholds on fraction of favourable days are uncalibrated assumptions.

spatial_model.description: Relative scouting priority on a local grid: exponential distance decay from reported symptomatic points, stretched downwind when forecast wind direction is consistent; reduced near prior observations reported clear. Weather favourability is reported separately (farm-level). Not an infection probability.
spatial_model.note: Wind and rain-splash dispersal are documented; decay length, stretch and grid size are uncalibrated layout assumptions for scouting, not fitted dispersal kernels. Grid cells are never finer than the reported position uncertainty, and the kernel length is broadened by it (L_eff = sqrt(L^2 + r^2)); see docs/science/spatial-model.md.

guidance_scope.applicability: Biology (free water, temperature range, latency, dispersal, lower-canopy onset) is pathogen-level and applies across regions. Practical guidance is drawn mainly from Hawaiʻi extension publications; only generic measures (inspection, sanitation, movement limits, re-scouting, consulting extension, resistant cultivars) are retained. Hawaiʻi-specific regulatory reporting, product lists and contacts are deliberately omitted. Rwanda-specific guidance (RAB/Plantwise 2012) and a Rwandan farm survey (Bigirimana et al. 2012) were added; product names and doses in the RAB factsheet are intentionally not reproduced.

differentials.description: Other biotic stresses producing leaf spots/damage on coffee (BRACOL classes; PD-118). A confident differential signal blocks 'supported' and is listed for the reviewer.

severity.input: optional numeric 'affected_leaf_area_pct' (0-100) on a rust signal
severity.method: OIRSA leaf-area classes as used by RoCoLe
severity.note: Leaf-level severity of the photographed leaf, not plot incidence.

aliases_note: Synonyms used by client vocabularies (frontend farmer report). Unmapped labels stay unrecognised and cannot raise the score.

rwanda_approx.note: Approximate Rwanda bounding box (lon_min, lat_min, lon_max, lat_max); includes parts of neighbouring countries (DRC, Burundi, Uganda, Tanzania). A match selects Rwanda-region context; it is not a country determination.
